subscribers-com.label: Subscribers.com
subscribers-com.description: Web push notification service (subscribers.com). Loads an opt-in prompt and registers a push service worker. PATTERN: host-level `cdn.subscribers.com` covers both shipped scripts, `/assets/subscribers.js` (the documented embed) and `/assets/subscribers-sw.js` (the service worker). The host is a dedicated single-vendor CDN with no third-party content on it, so a host pattern carries no over-blocking risk and matches how OneSignal (`cdn.onesignal.com`) and PushEngage (`clientcdn.pushengage.com`) are already catalogued. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: `app.subscribers.com/api/v1/`, `hi.subscribers.com` (telemetry beacon) and `apn.subscribers.com/apn` (Safari legacy push). These are fetch/XHR/beacon endpoints called from the bundle, not script or iframe sources, so a script pattern would never match them and adding them would be misleading. COOKIE: one only, `isPushNotificationClient`, which suppresses the opt-in prompt after a visitor dismisses it. Duration is publisher-configurable: 7 days by default, and the "never show again" sentinel is rewritten to 3650 days. Confirmed by reading the live minified bundle; `document.cookie` is touched in exactly two places. Note `__cfduid` appears against this host in Cookiepedia but is a stale Cloudflare cookie, not a vendor cookie, and should not be attributed here. CATEGORY NOTE FOR REVIEW: filed as `functional` to stay consistent with OneSignal and PushEngage, which are direct competitors already published as `functional`, and because the single cookie is a prompt-suppression preference rather than a tracking identifier. An argument exists for `marketing`, since the product's purpose is promotional re-engagement and DuckDuckGo Tracker Radar scores it fingerprinting: 2. Worth a deliberate decision at approval: if `marketing` is preferred, OneSignal and PushEngage should move with it rather than leaving three near-identical services split across two categories. SOURCE: found leaking pre-consent on a customer site in ticket 1521922. Absent from Open Cookie Database, Cookiepedia and other public cookie databases; EasyPrivacy carries only the broad `||subscribers.com^$third-party`.
